en: The postcard features a monochrome illustration of a distressed woman in traditional clothing standing upright and looking upwards, likely at an airplane. Behind her, other figures appear to be huddled or lying on the ground, possibly injured or mourning, with rural buildings and what looks like destruction or smoke in the background. There is a postal stamp on the right side, though it is partially illegible. The caption reads 'A passing Aeroplane.' and beneath the illustration, another line reads 'And to think that there are still neutrals!'
